allowlist.reason: Non-applicable: advisory targets Scrapy's S3DownloadHandler sending signed S3 requests over plaintext HTTP. Baluffo never uses s3:// URLs or S3 storage (no s3download/boto references in src/ or tests/), so the vulnerable code path is unreachable. Revisit at review_by: either upgrade scrapy>=2.17 (scrapy-playwright supports scrapy>=2.7) or extend this entry.
